newsitem.title: SUDAN: Tens of thousands flee south Sudan fighting - MP.
newsitem.headline: Tens of thousands flee south Sudan fighting - MP.

text.p: Tens of thousands of Sudanese civilians have fled towards the southern town of Juba from surrounding areas because of the fighting in the area between the army and southern rebels, a local member of parliament said.

Munir Somit, member for the southern town of Yei, was quoted in the independent newspaper Alwan on Tuesday as saying the displaced people were from Yei and from 18 villages and were in dire need of relief and medical assistance.
The rebel Sudan People's Liberation Army (SPLA) said last week it had captured Yei from the army and advanced within 50 km (30 miles) of Juba, 130 km (80 miles) to the northeast.

On Saturday the official news agency SUNA quoted the commissioner for refugees, Mohamed Hussein, as saying a large number of refugees from Uganda and Zaire had poured into Juba. The agency did not give numbers.
The rebels said on Tuesday they had seized the southern army garrison town of Kajo-Kaji and now controlled Sudan's borders with neighbouring Zaire and Uganda.
